name: Mako Lowcut Canvas
description: A classic low-cut canvas sneaker with a vulcanized rubber sole. Flat, simple, and available in about thirty colorways including a few with faded geometric prints. The kind of shoe that's been around in one form or another for two hundred years.
what_it_says: You're not trying to prove anything. Maybe that's the point.
worn_by: people who've given up on comfort
story_hooks: A particular colorway — grey with a red stripe — has become associated with a specific Shelf crew. Wearing it in the wrong block is a problem.
Mako has made the Lowcut for sixty years without changing the design. They're proud of this.
